remarks: Located in the most convenient and growing area of Hawthorne(North Hawthorne), this lovely end-unit townhome is up for sale. With the most practical HOA cost and an open floor plan, the 3-bedroom and 2.25-bathroom home has been completely renovated to its own character. Contemporary style new wooden cabinets  &  quartz countertops have been updated in the kitchen and bathrooms. New laminate floor  &  new paint throughout the inside. The living room and the dining area communicate well and connect to the open kitchen. This great floor plan flows with abundant natural light and makes the inside super bright and airy.
